sources.title: Research on Marital Satisfaction and Stability in the 2010s: Challenging Conventional Wisdom
sources.author: Benjamin R. Karney and Thomas N. Bradbury (2020)
sources.type: primary research review, selected opening sections inspected
sources.sections: Abstract and introductory discussion of varied trajectories and context
sources.supported_use: Attend to differences between relationships and contextual constraints.
sources.limits: Abstract and opening discussion only; much underlying work concerns different-sex couples. No universal stage sequence, causal exercise claim or individual prediction.

sources.title: The Cognitive Dimension of Household Labor
sources.author: Allison Daminger (2019)
sources.type: primary empirical paper, publisher abstract inspected
sources.sections: Abstract describing cognitive work in household labor
sources.supported_use: Notice planning and monitoring as well as visible execution.
sources.limits: Abstract-only use; interview sample does not prescribe roles by gender, provide a universal fairness metric or validate the meal exercise.

sources.title: An Exploration of the Structure of Effective Apologies
sources.author: Roy J. Lewicki, Beth Polin and Robert B. Lount Jr. (2016)
sources.type: primary empirical paper, publisher abstract inspected
sources.sections: Abstract on apology components and perceived effectiveness
sources.supported_use: Distinguish the structure of an apology from later behavioral evidence.
sources.limits: Abstract-only use; no claim about which component is strongest, durable couples repair or clinical effectiveness. Three-part task design is original.

sources.title: Consent 101: Respect, Boundaries, and Building Trust
sources.author: RAINN; updated May 31, 2026
sources.sections: Consent, ongoing choice, withdrawal, pressure and assumptions sections
sources.supported_use: Recognize specific voluntary permission and the need to stop at withdrawal or unresolved capacity.
sources.limits: Not a jurisdiction-specific legal determination or assessment of an individual. No numeric age rule, disability-based incapacity assumption, visible-enthusiasm requirement or safety guarantee.

sources.title: Contraception and Birth Control Methods
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention; August 6, 2024
sources.sections: Opening choice considerations and distinction from sexually transmitted infection protection
sources.supported_use: Separate pregnancy prevention from infection prevention and preserve informed voluntary choice.
sources.limits: Only these general distinctions are used; no method selection, dosage, effectiveness percentage, medication change or clinical recommendation is reproduced.

sources.title: Defining sexual health
sources.author: World Health Organization
sources.sections: Working definitions of sexual health and related rights/context
sources.supported_use: Place wellbeing, respectful interaction and freedom from coercion in the discussion.
sources.limits: Working definitions, not an individualized clinical standard, activity requirement, pleasure quota or validation of this conversational agenda.

sources.title: What are my boundaries?
sources.author: love is respect / National Domestic Violence Hotline
sources.sections: Communicating boundaries, healthy limits versus control, digital privacy and changing boundaries
sources.supported_use: Differentiate personal boundaries and truthful communication from control and compulsory account access.
sources.limits: Youth-serving source; these live routes are voluntary adults only. No diagnosis from jealousy, automatic legal conclusion or browser-privacy guarantee.

sources.title: Get a divorce
sources.author: GOV.UK
sources.sections: Jurisdiction scope and separate arrangements for children, money, property and housing
sources.supported_use: Illustrate that relationship ending does not itself resolve related legal and practical matters.
sources.limits: England and Wales only; no assumption the learner lives there. No eligibility, fee, waiting-period or local legal advice imported; qualified local guidance remains necessary.

sources.title: About the Committee on Consensual Non-Monogamy
sources.author: APA Division 44 Committee on Consensual Non-Monogamy
sources.sections: Definition and distinction from infidelity through explicit partner agreement
sources.supported_use: Distinguish consensual structures from a concealed breach of an actual promise.
sources.limits: Definition-level use only; no prevalence, superiority, comparative satisfaction or universal legal-recognition claim. Orientation and structure remain separate.

sources.title: Planning for Pregnancy
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention; July 14, 2026
sources.sections: Opening planning context and talking with a health-care provider
sources.supported_use: Prepare individualized questions for qualified care.
sources.limits: No fertility forecast, supplement dose, testing schedule, weight target or medication advice imported. A consultation is not consent to parenthood or a guaranteed outcome.

sources.title: Triangles
sources.author: The Bowen Center for the Study of the Family
sources.type: primary institutional explanation of a theoretical model
sources.sections: Opening description of three-person relationship routes and tension
sources.supported_use: Offer a limited lens for observing indirect communication.
sources.limits: Theory, not a universal proven cause or diagnosis. Clinical illness-causation language and the source family example are not imported; unknown trauma/history stays unknown.

sources.title: Positive Parenting Tips for Healthy Child Development: Middle Childhood (6–8 years of age)
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (2015)
sources.sections: Two-page sheet, especially positive parenting guidance and safety
sources.supported_use: Use achievable tasks, clear expectations, modeling and supportive guidance.
sources.limits: Historical educational sheet, not an individualized current assessment. Dated lifestyle quantities and milestone assertions are not imported. No parenting or attachment score.

sources.title: Steps for Creating and Maintaining a Care Plan
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention; September 3, 2024
sources.sections: Overview, developing a plan, privacy and caregiver health
sources.supported_use: Organize responsibilities, include the recipient and maintain appropriate updates.
sources.limits: Clinical form fields and medical-outcome claims are not imported. The learning record is bounded logistics, not a clinical care plan or medication instruction.

sources.title: Plan for Safety
sources.author: National Domestic Violence Hotline
sources.sections: Personalized safety planning and responsibility for abusive behavior
sources.supported_use: Unsafe or coercive situations need an individualized support route.
sources.limits: US service context; verify appropriate local resources and safe contact. No personalized plan, compulsory joint discussion, promised safety or browser-history protection.

sources.title: Supported Decision Making Program
sources.author: Administration for Community Living; modified July 17, 2023
sources.sections: Opening account of person-chosen support tailored to types of decisions
sources.supported_use: Preserve the recipient’s voice and distinguish task-specific support.
sources.limits: No assessment of capacity, grant of guardianship powers or claim that a chosen arrangement changes local legal authority. Existing lawful arrangements and qualified guidance remain relevant.
